# openwrt_system_led (Resource)

An LED trigger (`config led`).

Manages a `led` section in `/etc/config/system`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.
- `sysfs` (String) LED name under /sys/class/leds. (UCI option `sysfs`.)

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Initial state. (UCI option `default`.)
- `delayoff` (Number) timer trigger: off time in ms. (UCI option `delayoff`.)
- `delayon` (Number) timer trigger: on time in ms. (UCI option `delayon`.)
- `dev` (String) netdev trigger: device. (UCI option `dev`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `inverted` (Boolean) Invert the LED. (UCI option `inverted`.)
- `mode` (String) netdev trigger: modes, e.g. `link tx rx`. (UCI option `mode`.)
- `name` (String) Descriptive name. (UCI option `name`.)
- `trigger` (String) Trigger: `none`, `default-on`, `timer`, `netdev`, `heartbeat`, ... (UCI option `trigger`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
